';
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-adults.webp']='data:image/webp;base64,';
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-group.webp']='data:image/webp;base64,';
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-ball.webp']='data:image/webp;base64,';
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-back.webp']='data:image/webp;base64,';

// Brand crest / favicon. Keep the horizontal wordmark asset unchanged in the desktop header.
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/wjo-crest.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-logo.webp'];
try{
  let fav=document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]');
  if(!fav){fav=document.createElement('link');fav.rel='icon';document.head.appendChild(fav)}
  fav.href=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-logo.webp'];
}catch(e){}

// Rotate the approved photos instead of reusing one picture across many tiles.
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/hero-black-gi-child.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-young.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/program-superjs.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-young.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/program-adults.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-adults.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v59-adults.webp']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-adults.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/tile-confidence.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-teen.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/tile-fitness.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-group.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/tile-self-defence.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-adults.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/tile-character.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v63-discipline.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/superj-play.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-young.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/superj-progress.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v63-confident.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/superj-next.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v63-superjs.webp'];

// Adult tiles: deliberately varied but restricted to the approved/correct uniform photography.
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/adults-practical.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-adults.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/adults-efficient.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-teen.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/adults-biomechanical.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-group.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/adults-mindbody.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v63-adults.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/adults-tactical.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v63-montage.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/adults-simple.png']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v63-discipline.webp'];

// Uniform and event artwork: no white gi imagery and no blank event artwork.
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/shop-uniforms.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-back.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/event-autumn-ball.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-ball.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/event-white-to-brown.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-group.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/event-junior-black.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-teen.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/event-adult-degree.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-adults.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/event-brown-tags.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v65-back.webp'];
WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/event-levels.jpg']=WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/v63-discipline.webp'];

// Re-resolve any logo images that were rendered before the final asset override.
setTimeout(()=>{
  try{
    document.querySelectorAll('img[src="assets/wjo-crest.png"]').forEach(img=>img.src=resolveAssetPath('assets/wjo-crest.png'));
  }catch(e){}
},0);

const v65Style=document.createElement('style');
v65Style.textContent=`
/* V65: WJO Black Belt is plain black. Only the two Brown TAG stages carry centre stripes. */
.black i,.belt-swatch-v55.black,.belt-card.black{background:#070809!important;background-image:none!important;border-color:#41464e!important}
.v60-grade-card.black .belt-swatch-v55{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.09),0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.025)!important}
/* Circular crest with no square/background artefact. */
.wjo-intro-crest-v29,.prod-admin-brand img,.prod-login-logo img,.brand-v37-logo,.phone-top img{object-fit:contain!important;background:transparent!important;border:none!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.wjo-intro-crest-v29{clip-path:none!important;border-radius:0!important}
/* Use event imagery as a real image, never an empty dark rectangle. */
.v62-event-thumb img,.v62-home-event-image img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover!important}
`;
document.head.appendChild(v65Style);

// V65 release identity for local CMS backup.
if(typeof cmsExportData==='function'){
  cmsExportData=function(){const d=cmsData();const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(d,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-backup-v65.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','V65 content was exported as JSON.')};window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData;
}
// ======================= END V65 =======================


// ======================= V66 LOGO REPAIR =======================
const v66LogoStyle=document.createElement('style');
v66LogoStyle.textContent=`
/* Keep the approved circular crest intact everywhere. Never crop it with cover/clip-path. */
.brand-v38 img,.brand-v37-logo,.wjo-intro-crest-v29,.prod-admin-brand img,.prod-login-logo img,.mobile-head img,
.cms-event-placeholder-v44 img,.phone-top img{
  object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;clip-path:none!important;border-radius:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:0!important;
}
.brand-v38 img{width:60px!important;height:60px!important;flex:0 0 60px!important;display:block!important}
.wjo-intro-crest-v29{width:86px!important;height:86px!important;display:block!important;margin:0 auto 28px!important}
.prod-admin-brand img{width:48px!important;height:48px!important}
.prod-login-logo img{width:92px!important;height:92px!important}
@media(max-width:1000px){
  .header .brand-v38{margin:0 auto!important;justify-content:center!important;min-width:0!important}
  .header .brand-v38 img{width:58px!important;height:58px!important;flex-basis:58px!important}
  .header .brand-v38-copy{display:none!important}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .wjo-intro-crest-v29{width:74px!important;height:74px!important;margin-bottom:26px!important}
}
`;
document.head.appendChild(v66LogoStyle);
// Ensure every asset alias used for the crest resolves to the approved V66 logo.
try{WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/wjo-crest.png']=V38_LOGO;WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/wjo-logo-darkbg.png']=V38_LOGO;}catch(e){}
// V66 local CMS backup identity.
if(typeof cmsExportData==='function'){
  cmsExportData=function(){const d=cmsData();const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(d,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-backup-v66.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','V66 content was exported as JSON.')};window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData;
}
// ===================== END V66 LOGO REPAIR =====================

window.addEventListener('hashchange',render);render();setTimeout(showWjoIntroV29,120);scheduleNewsletterV40();
</script>
</body>
</html>
